name: T01

theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

name: T02

theorem T02 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ

author: private-a0
name: Q01
source:
theorem Q01 : ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c := by
  intro a b c x ha hb
  have hsq : 0 ≤ (2*a*x+b)^2 := Int.sq_nonneg _
  have h : 0 ≤ 4*a*(a*x^2+b*x+c) := by
    have e : 4*a*(a*x^2+b*x+c) = (2*a*x+b)^2 + (4*a*c - b^2) := by grind
    rw [e]
    omega
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  have hneg : a*x^2+b*x+c < 0 := by omega
  have h4 : 0 < 4*a := by omega
  have := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg h4
  have e2 : (a*x^2+b*x+c)*(4*a) = 4*a*(a*x^2+b*x+c) := Int.mul_comm _ _
  omega
statement: ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c

author: private-a0
name: T03
source:
theorem T03 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T01]
  have a := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1 h4
  have b := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.le_of_lt (Int.add_pos h2 h3)) h5
  first | omega | grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0

author: private-a0
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  rw [T02] at h6
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have hS : m.S ≤ 0 := by omega
  have hN : 0 ≤ N ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_nonneg h5 h5
    have e : N ^ 2 = N * N := by grind
    omega
  have hM : 0 < M ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos h4 h4
    have e : M ^ 2 = M * M := by grind
    omega
  have e1 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)) hN
  have e2 : 0 ≤ (-m.S) * N * M :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) h5) (by omega)
  have e3 : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos h1 hM
  have e4 : (-m.S) * N * M = - (m.S * N * M) := by grind
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

author: private-a0
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hdet hM hN h hD
  rw [T02]
  have h1 : m.S * M * N ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N * N := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hN
  have h2 : 0 < m.detJ * (M * M) := Int.mul_pos hdet (Int.mul_pos hM hM)
  have h3 : m.S * N * M = m.S * M * N := by grind
  have h4 : m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 = m.Du * m.Dv * N * N := by grind
  have h5 : m.detJ * M ^ 2 = m.detJ * (M * M) := by grind
  rw [h3, h4, h5]
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: private-a0
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h6 : m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := by omega
  have := T05 m N M h1 h2 h3 h6 h4
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

author: private-a0
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s h1 hp h3 h4 n hn
  have e : ∀ x : Int, x ^ 2 = x * x := fun x => by
    first | exact Int.pow_two x | simp [Int.pow_succ] | grind
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    rw [e]
    exact Int.mul_pos hp hp
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sq_nonneg _)
  have hn1 : (1 : Int) ≤ (n : Int) := by omega
  have hn2 : (1 : Int) ≤ (n : Int) ^ 2 := by
    rw [e]
    exact Int.mul_le_mul hn1 hn1 (by omega) (by omega) |> fun h => by simpa using h
  have hK : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg h3 (Int.sq_nonneg s)
  have hk := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn2 hK
  have key : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeM Scope.modeN
    have : m.Du * m.Dv * (↑n ^ 2 * s ^ 2) = m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 * (n : Int) ^ 2 := by grind
    rw [this]
    grind
  exact Int.le_of_lt (T05 m _ _ h1 hM hN key h3)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

author: private-a0
name: T08
source:
theorem T08 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hpos hd
  rw [T02]
  have hM : 0 ≤ M ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg M
  have h1 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd hM
  have h2 : (-(m.S * M)) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * (m.detJ * M ^ 2) := by
    have e1 : (-(m.S * M)) ^ 2 = m.S ^ 2 * M ^ 2 := by grind
    have e2 : 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * (m.detJ * M ^ 2) = 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by grind
    rw [e1, e2]; exact h1
  have h := Q01 (m.Du * m.Dv) (-(m.S * M)) (m.detJ * M ^ 2) N hpos h2
  have e : m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 + -(m.S * M) * N + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by grind
  rw [e]; exact h
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M

theorem H01 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C := by

name: T09
source:
theorem T09 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  refine ⟨T04 m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6, ?_⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have := T08 m N M (Int.mul_pos h2 h3) (Int.not_lt.mp h)
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2

author: private-a0
name: T10
source:
theorem T10 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N := by
  intro m N M hM hN hD hneg
  have h := T02 m N M
  have h0 : 0 ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg hD (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have h1 : M * (m.detJ * M) < M * (m.S * N) := by
    have : m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 < 0 := by omega
    have e1 : M * (m.detJ * M) = m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by grind
    have e2 : M * (m.S * N) = m.S * N * M := by grind
    omega
  exact Int.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h1 (Int.le_of_lt hM)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N

author: private-a0
name: T11
source:
theorem T11 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2 := by
  intro m p s hd hp hDD hex
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := hex
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    have e0 : Scope.modeM p = p * p := by
      unfold Scope.modeM
      grind
    rw [e0]
    exact Int.mul_pos hp hp
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sq_nonneg _)
  have h6 := T06 m (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) hd hM hN hDD h
  unfold Scope.modeN Scope.modeM at h6
  have h1 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have h2 : 1*1 ≤ (n:Int)*(n:Int) := Int.mul_le_mul h1 h1 (by omega) (by omega)
  have e2 : (n:Int)^2 = (n:Int)*(n:Int) := by grind
  have hn2 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int)^2 := by
    rw [e2]
    have h2' := h2
    rwa [Int.one_mul] at h2'
  have hX : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg hDD (Int.sq_nonneg s)
  have h3 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn2 hX
  have e : m.Du * m.Dv * ((n:Int)^2 * s^2) = (m.Du * m.Dv * s^2) * (n:Int)^2 := by
    grind
  rw [e] at h6
  rw [Int.mul_one] at h3
  exact Int.lt_of_le_of_lt h3 h6
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2

author: private-a0
name: T12
source:
theorem T12 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M) := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7
  exact ⟨T03 m N M h1 h3 h4 h5 h6, T05 m N M h2 h5 h6 h7 (Int.le_of_lt (Int.mul_pos h3 h4))⟩
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M)
